[#crypto-performance]
=== Throughput

How long each family's fixed operation takes on each backend and target, the operation
the size matrix's programs call (bench/operations.hpp). A dated reference, measured by
hand, that decides nothing: every default is chosen by the reason
<<crypto-backends-defaults>> states, whatever these figures say.

Measured on 2026-11-18 on Apple M5 Max (arm64),
18 cores, 128 GiB, Darwin 27.0.0;
WebAssembly under wasmtime 47.0.3 (5554cc1a6 2026-07-31) (wasip2, wasip3) and node
v26.13.0 (Emscripten); built with variant=release. The CI's runners
are measured when the owner runs this by hand on them.

Each cell is the median of its invocations' medians, each of five timed runs, in
microseconds per operation, with the fastest and slowest single run beside it: the
spread is part of the result.

Compilers: native: Apple LLVM 21.0.0 (clang-2100.4.1.1); wasip2: Clang 23.1.0-wasi-sdk (https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project 895aa2c896ada719451be2e3673c83da8ddf1141); wasip3: Clang 23.1.0-wasi-sdk (https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project 895aa2c896ada719451be2e3673c83da8ddf1141); emscripten: Clang 24.0.0git (https:/github.com/llvm/llvm-project f718ebe873411a562ef6e5c27da36d75b7aaec98).

OpenSSL is not built for Emscripten, so its rows are native and WASI only; on WASI it
is built `no-asm`, natively with its assembly.

libsodium's x86-64 assembly (design D7): Ed25519 signature, libsodium with HAVE_AMD64_ASM; X25519 agreement, libsodium with HAVE_AMD64_ASM: not measured yet. x86-64 assembly runs only on an x86-64 machine; this page's machine is arm64. D7 asks for the rows recorded, never used: webcpp builds libsodium without it.
